## What Lives In The Lab {#laboratory-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="section-card-grid">
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Work A System</span>
    <h3>Hydrology, Geomorphology, and Water Quality</h3>
    <p>Rivers, reservoirs, erosion, coastal processes, and contaminant transport turn methods into integrated environmental problems.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Test A Sensor</span>
    <h3>Radar and Geophysical Investigations</h3>
    <p>SAR, InSAR, GRACE, and passive microwave chapters connect advanced sensing to specific modelling questions.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Model A City</span>
    <h3>Urban and Transportation Studies</h3>
    <p>Urban climate, accessibility, demographic change, and network analysis show how the lab extends into cities and infrastructure.</p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Push The Methods</span>
    <h3>Inference and Data Assimilation</h3>
    <p>Bayesian methods, ensembles, Kalman filtering, and satellite assimilation push into the more technical side of model practice.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```
